risk_description: Trim parts of the backrest on both front seats can detach during rear airbag deployment in the event of an accident.  The airbag deployment may be impaired and the airbag itself may be damaged, increasing the risk of injury to rear occupants.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
